description: v3 pre-registration config (v1.16 P0-3; values approved by the owner 2026-10-14): v2 plus the net-of-cost realism keys — assumed venue latency with a parametric tail, latency stress grid, assumed fee tier with lower-tier sensitivity, ITCH exec-print fills, and parent-order impact from the residual-move calibration fit. Read with iap.execution.realism.load_prereg.

execution_realism.description: v1.14 options, OFF in code defaults, ON for v2. feed_latency_ns is an assumed market-data feed leg (real ITCH has exchange timestamps only), not a measurement. modify_queue_credit has no switch (always on since v1.14) and is recorded for completeness. v1.16: venue_latency is ASSUMED (real ITCH carries no order-entry latency); latency_stress {0,1,5}x is reported, the 1x case is primary; fee_tier from configs/reference/fee_tiers.json (assumed), sensitivity at the lower 'base' tier is reported only; impact_model parent + impact_shape sqrt needs estimate_calibration(impact_fit=True).
